description:
A seismological institute has published a PostGIS-backed layer of real USGS earthquake events (M5.0+, January–March 2024) in GeoServer, but the time dimension has not been configured yet. The web mapping team needs time-enabled WMS so their JavaScript client can filter and animate earthquakes by date.

Your task is to configure the WMS time dimension on the 'earthquakes' layer in the 'seismic' workspace:

1. Navigate to the 'earthquakes' layer configuration in the GeoServer web admin (Data > Layers > seismic:earthquakes > Edit)
2. Go to the 'Dimensions' tab
3. Enable the 'Time' dimension checkbox
4. Set the 'Attribute' to 'event_time'
5. Set the 'Presentation' mode to 'List'
6. Under 'Default Value', select the strategy 'Use the biggest domain value' (this shows the most recent events by default)
7. Save the layer configuration

After saving, the WMS GetCapabilities response should advertise the time dimension for this layer, and time-filtered WMS GetMap requests (using the TIME parameter) should return correctly filtered map images.

GeoServer admin credentials: admin / Admin123!
GeoServer URL: http://localhost:8080/geoserver/web/
